negative_findings.description: No separate, standalone public NBS register of payment-service AGENTS (agenti platobných služieb) or distributors of e-money was located as its own page; agent records appear to be embedded inside the PSD2 register/subjekty database rather than published as a distinct list.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in sk for 'register agentov platobných služieb' surfaced only the general PSD2 register and the subjekty.nbs.sk database.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Agent counts are a leading indicator of distribution build-out; if they are only inside the PSD2 JSON, extraction must parse nested agent records rather than expect a list page.

negative_findings.description: No SK register specifically enumerating card acquirers, independent ATM deployers (IAD) or POS terminal operators was found; these activities are not separately licensed and therefore not separately registered.
negative_findings.result_summary: Register searches across NBS, EBA and company registers returned no acquirer/ATM-operator-specific list.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The acquiring and ATM/POS cells cannot be populated from a register alone — they must be assembled by joining licence registers with SK NACE codes in RPO and with NBS payment statistics.

negative_findings.description: ORSR (orsr.sk) exposes no official public API or bulk export; access is via a legacy web search UI only, with third parties (Slovensko.Digital) supplying the API layer.
negative_findings.result_summary: Confirmed by the ORSR about page and by the existence of third-party mirror APIs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Bulk company-data collection depends on a third-party re-publisher whose terms and continuity are outside our control; a sourcing risk to record.

negative_findings.description: Exact current URLs for Obchodný vestník and for the Štatistický úrad RPO landing page were not confirmed by direct fetch within this pass; the institutions and registers themselves are certain, the paths are hypotheses.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search results referenced these registers via portal pages and third-party descriptions rather than the canonical entry URL.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic liveness pass should expect redirects here rather than treating a non-200 as a dead source.

coverage_gaps.description: Inbound/outbound passporting notices for SK (which EU PIs/EMIs are notified to operate into Slovakia) were not located as a dedicated NBS page; only the EBA register was confirmed as carrying passport data.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch the EBA PSD2 register bulk file and inspect its passporting fields for host-country SK; separately search nbs.sk for 'notifikácia' / 'cezhraničné poskytovanie služieb'.

coverage_gaps.description: All registers found expose current state only; no register was confirmed to publish historical snapshots, so entry/exit dating depends on our own diffing from the first collection date onward.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Begin daily/weekly snapshotting of subjekty.nbs.sk JSON and the EBA bulk file immediately; backfill history from Obchodný vestník and RÚZ filing dates.

coverage_gaps.description: NBS licence withdrawals, sanctions and enforcement decisions (Vestník NBS / rozhodnutia) were referenced but not pinned to a specific collectable URL in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search nbs.sk for 'vestník NBS', 'rozhodnutia NBS', 'sankcie', 'odňatie povolenia' and add the decisions archive as a dated exit-event source.

coverage_gaps.description: ESMA registers (CASP under MiCA, crowdfunding providers) and the EBA credit-institutions register were identified only at hub level, not as SK-filtered endpoints.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Resolve the concrete ESMA register URLs and confirm whether SK filtering and bulk download are available.

coverage_gaps.description: Commercial SK company-data vendors (e.g. FinStat and similar) were not evaluated in this pass; they often add computed financial ratios and industry aggregates on top of the public registers.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout SK commercial company-data vendors and record licence terms, since register-derived market-share work may be faster to buy than to build.

brief: Slovakia's register layer is unusually well structured for pointer work: NBS runs the statutory PSD2 register with a daily-updated, digitally signed JSON endpoint at subjekty.nbs.sk, backed by a broader supervised-entity database and a register index that also covers creditors, financial agents, CERI disclosures and the new MiCA/CASP licensing stream. Above it, the EBA PSD2 register and ECB MFI/SSM lists give an EU-consistent, bulk-downloadable view including cross-border passporting into SK that the national list understates. Below it, the company layer — ORSR, the statistical RPO with SK NACE codes, RPVS for beneficial ownership, Obchodný vestník for dated entry/exit events, and above all the Register účtovných závierok open API — converts any register-derived entity list into revenue and asset time series, which is what turns this pointer cell into quantitative market-structure output. The main structural gap is that acquiring, ATM deployment and POS operation are not separately licensed and therefore appear in no register; those cells must be built by joining licence lists to NACE-coded entity sets and to NBS payment statistics, and entry/exit history must be manufactured by snapshotting from now on, since no register publishes its own historical states.
